opportunities.title: Autumn 2026 Funding Round

amount.raw: Grants of up to £20,000 for individuals undertaking research travel and/or taking time to address specific research questions. Grants of up to £40,000 for organisations undertaking ambitious and sustained research in the field of British art.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Individuals at different stages of their careers and organisations undertaking research in British art.
opportunities.summary: The Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art offers grants and funding opportunities for individuals and organisations to support research in British art. The Autumn 2026 round includes grants for organisations and Author Grants for individuals.
